narration.text: ልጅ እያለሁ እናቴ ልብስ ልትገዛልኝ በከተማችን ወዳሉ ትናንሽ ሱቆች ወሰደችኝ።

shots.subtitle_en: When I was a kid, my mother took me to a street of small boutiques in our town.

shots.reason: The want: the boy spots the jeans
shots.image_prompt: the small boy seen from behind pointing at a pair of blue jeans hanging in a boutique doorway, a bicycle leaning against the wall nearby

narration.text: ወደ አንዱ ሱቅ ከገባን በኋላ የትኛውን እንደምፈልግ ጠየቀችኝ፤ አንድ ጂንስ ሱሪ አመለከትኩ።

shots.subtitle_en: She asked which one I liked. I pointed at a pair of jeans.

shots.image_prompt: the mother seen from behind facing the shop owner in silhouette inside a small boutique, jeans on the wall
shots.motion_prompt: very slow push-in, soft light flicker

narration.text: ባለሱቁን ስንት እንደሆነ ጠየቀችው፤ ሁለት ሺህ ብር አለ።

shots.subtitle_en: She asked the owner the price. Two thousand birr, he said.

shots.image_prompt: close-up of the mother's calm hand with a small gesture, warm light, shop counter
the small boy seen from behind near the shop door, head bowed, shoulders shrunk, bright street beyond

narration.text: ወየው ጉዴ! መሬት ተከፍታ ብትውጠኝ ተመኘሁ።

shots.subtitle_en: I wanted the ground to swallow me.

shots.image_prompt: the shop owner's raised open hands in a refusing gesture, silhouette, warm shop light

narration.text: ኧረ ማዘርየ፣ ከቤቱም እንዲህ አይመጣም አለ ባለሱቁ።

shots.subtitle_en: Come on, mother, I can't even get it at that price, the owner said.

shots.image_prompt: the mother seen from behind turning toward the shop door, shawl swinging, bright street ahead
shots.motion_prompt: slow gentle track following her, soft wind

narration.text: በል እንግዲያውስ ልሂድ አለች እናቴ፤ ወደ በሩ እያመራች።

shots.subtitle_en: Then I'm leaving, said my mother, as she headed toward the door.

shots.reason: The price drops to 1000, she still refuses
shots.image_prompt: the shop owner in silhouette with an outstretched hand calling after the mother, who shakes her head, seen from behind

narration.text: ባለሱቁም፣ ማዘር በቃ አንድ ሺህ ብር ይውሰዱት ብሎ ጠራት፤ እሷ ግን ራሷን ነቀነቀች።

shots.subtitle_en: One thousand, he called after her. She shook her head.

shots.reason: The mother turns back and makes her final offer
shots.image_prompt: the mother in a cream patterned shawl, seen from behind, turning toward the shop owner, one hand gently gesturing as she makes her final offer, the shop owner standing inside the small boutique in silhouette, jeans hanging on the wall, warm golden afternoon light
shots.motion_prompt: gentle camera push-in, subtle movement of the mother's hand and shawl

narration.text: እናቴም ዞር ብላ ባለሱቁን፣ አምስት መቶ ብር ይሆንልሃል? የመጨረሻ ዋጋዬ ነው። ልጄ ስለወደደው ነው።

shots.subtitle_en: My mother turned back and said, Would five hundred birr work for you? That's my final offer. My child really likes it

shots.reason: The shop owner finally agrees with a friendly response
shots.image_prompt: the shop owner in a dark waistcoat, shown only as a warm silhouette, smiling gently and extending one hand in agreement toward the mother, the mother seen from behind in her cream patterned shawl, small Ethiopian boutique interior, golden afternoon light
shots.motion_prompt: slight movement of the shop owner's hand as he agrees, slow gentle push-in

narration.text: ባለሱቁም ፈገግ ብሎ፣ እሺ ማዘር፣ በአምስት መቶ ብር ውሰጂው። ዋናዉ ደንበኝነቱ ነው ሌላም ጥሩ እቃዎች አሉኝ አላት።

shots.subtitle_en: The shop owner smiled and said, Alright, mother, take it for five hundred birr. But from today on, you're my customer.

shots.image_prompt: close-up of hands counting birr notes over a wooden counter, warm light, no text on the notes
shots.motion_prompt: slow gentle push-in, subtle hand movement
shots.subtitle_en: In the end, we bought them for five hundred.

shots.reason: The lesson, stated by the narrator
shots.image_prompt: the small boy walking home from behind holding a paper bag, his mother beside him in silhouette, golden light on the street

narration.text: በዚያ ቀን አንድ ነገር ተማርኩ። በይሉኝታ አንድ ነገር ማጣት ጥሩ አይደለም፤ ደግነትም እንኳ አይደለም።

shots.subtitle_en: I learned something that day. Being ashamed, and losing because of it, is not good. It is not even kindness.
